candidate_reports.remark: Numerous reports of trees and power poles down across roads around the Greenville community_ likely due to the strong outflow boundary ahead of the storms. Reports via local radio station.
Numerous trees were reported down along the Alabama river in the Eureka Landing community in Monroe County_ AL..
Reports of trees and power poles down in the Georgiana community_ likely due to the strong outflow boundary ahead of the storms. Reports via local radio station.
Multiple reports of trees and power poles down in the McKenzie community_ likely due to the strong outflow boundary ahead of the storms. Reports via local radio station.
A few trees reported down in and around the Opp community in Covington County_ AL.
Several downed trees and power poles around the Opp community.
Reports of trees down blocking roads along with broken power poles and lines across the road between the Yarbo and Millry communities. Reports via the Yarbo Fire Department.
NOS station FRMA1 on Fort Morgan measured a marine gust of 40mph in thunderstorms.
Site DILA1 measured a wind gust of 41 mph.
Reports of standing water on I-10 westbound before exit 10. Photos from social media and confirmed by FDOT cameras and traffic remarks.
